In studying the [[Waveworn Phenomenon]], scientists discovered '''Tacetite''' - a substance that can permanently hold [[Remnant]] Energy.<ref>[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#lore Wuthering Waves Official Website], Remnant
:''In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite" — a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords.''</ref>

==Overview==
===Tacetite Weapons===
When modified, Tacetite can become a potent energy weapon for [[Resonator]]s, capable of harming the [[Tacet Discord]]s. 

The core modules of these weapons are charged with Energy Cores, supplements storing Tacetite Energy. Resonators are advised to perform routine maintenance on their weapons to ensure they currently are retaining charge, and experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat Energy Cores to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.

In [[Jinzhou]], the Ministry of Development once developed Tacetite Weapons to allow non-Resonator units in the [[Midnight Rangers]] fight against Tacet Discord. However, since they did not possess [[Forte]] and prolonged exposure posed health risks, the output of the weapons was limited for safety.<ref>{{Quest|Grand Warstorm}}</ref>

===Tacetite Ore===
The [[Black Shores]] headquarters is built upon a mass of Tacetite ore. This is what causes [[Blake Bloom]]s to lose their color.<ref>[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1#Blake Bloom|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 1, Blake Bloom]]
:''Shaped by the unique environment of the Black Shores, the rare Remnant plant has since become the region's symbol. Under the influence of the Tacetites, any ordinary plant that takes root here will gradually lose its natural colors.''</ref>
